privateAdministration: Private CLI plus authenticated batch upload under closure/admin-spec.json
parserBoundary: SQLeanParser parses and schema-checks finite templates before generation; only registered parameterized statements execute at runtime. Fixed DDL and connection controls are separately trusted.

claims.requirement: SQLite is authoritative; exact ordered legacy migration; existing invalid DB never falls back or gets overwritten.
All data queries derive from actual SQLeanParser parsed, validated, round-tripped templates; artifact mismatches and unsupported templates fail closed.
Typed parameters are bound; malicious predicate/ID text cannot alter SQL structure or execute an additional statement.

Private imports require one or more distinct contained, parsed/type-checked oracles; Alloy API must find satisfiable facts and bounded equivalence of every additional oracle/correct body to primary. Counterexamples, malformed bodies, unsupported cases and timeouts reject atomically. First oracle controls behavior independently of pool order.
Import is atomic, duplicates never overwrite, schema/integrity checks reject invalid relational state.
Learner routes read only; authenticated admin writes follow the separate admin specification. Existing public projection excludes private predicates and DB/parser/config artifacts.
SQLite-only deployment includes data/query dependencies, consistent snapshots and administrator additions; no original source checkout or Lean runtime needed.
Private database/import publication rejects unsafe paths and never modifies an existing DB implicitly.
Previous/Next follow filtered order, disable at edges/loading, preserve drafts and invalidate stale work.

excluded: Unbounded equivalence and agreement of primary oracle with natural-language specification
